identity.name: **Sombrero-Opus-14B-Sm5**
identity.summary: Sombrero-Opus-14B-Sm5 is a text-generation model built on the Qwen 2.5 14B architecture, aimed at improving coding efficiency and computational reasoning.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-generation model fine-tuned for coding and computational reasoning with no reported evaluation of factual accuracy or output grounding -> hallucination risk in generated code/answers

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight coding/reasoning model with no reported safety or reliability evaluations -> users may over-rely on plausible but incorrect code or reasoning outputs

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text-generation model with no stated safeguards or evaluation against copyrighted code or IP being included in prompts -> IP in prompt risk

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text-generation model with no stated safeguards or evaluation against confidential code or data being included in prompts -> confidential data in prompt risk

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,531,962,384 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a fine-tune that used specialized datasets to enhance code generation, structured programming logic, and problem-solving capabilities.
training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on specialized datasets aimed at improving code generation, structured programming logic, and problem-solving.
